Activity 5: Escape Room Challenge
  - Description: Teams work together to solve puzzles and escape from a themed escape room within a time limit.
  - Objective: To improve collaboration, communication under pressure, and problem-solving in a fun, immersive environment.
  - Location: Downtown Escape Rooms
  - Date: Quarterly rotation
  - Time: 2 hours

Activity 6: Community Service Day
  - Description: Teams participate in volunteer activities such as local cleanup, food bank assistance, or mentoring programs.
  - Objective: To build teamwork through shared purpose, give back to the community, and strengthen team bonds through meaningful service.
  - Location: Varies (local community organizations)
  - Date: Bi-annually
  - Time: 4-6 hours
